system.description:
Mountain Dwarf

Mountain dwarves are the quintessential dwarves of legend — stout, hardy, and proud. They make their homes in the great mountain ranges of the world, carving elaborate holds deep into the rock. Mountain dwarves are the most common dwarven subrace and the one most likely to be encountered on the surface world. Their complexions tend toward ruddy or deep brown, their hair is typically black or brown, and they are stocky and heavily muscled. This subrace corresponds closely to the standard dwarf presented in the Player's Handbook.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Constitution: +1
  • Charisma: −1

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 60 feet.
  • Detect Stonework: Detect grade/slope on 1–5 in d6; new construction on 1–5; sliding walls on 1–4; stonework traps on 1–3; depth underground on 1–3.
  • Attack Bonus: +1 to attack rolls vs. orcs, half-orcs, goblins, and hobgoblins.
  • Defensive Bonus: −4 AC vs. giants, ogres, trolls, ogre magi, and titans.
  • Saving Throw Bonus: +1 per 3.5 points of Constitution vs. magic and poison.
  • Stonecunning: Superior ability to work with stone; +2 to relevant crafting checks.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Cleric, Thief; Fighter/Cleric, Fighter/Thief multiclass.
